benchmark.label_scope: Author-curated exact-support labels on one previously unused official report; not human-blind annotation or semantic entailment.

gate.criteria: Label consistency 1.0, frozen-feature holdout rerank Recall@5 >= 0.80 and MRR >= 0.60.

decision: The frozen deterministic feature reranker transported to the source-disjoint report and slightly exceeded BM25 MRR, while the LSA-only and unweighted-RRF channels failed. Retain BM25 plus auditable feature reranking; do not describe the LSA channel as neural dense retrieval.
boundaries: The 14 labels are author-curated and small; the result is not independent human-blind annotation, answer entailment or production traffic.
The report was absent from the 20-claim development set, and retrieval features were frozen at the declared SHA before the first holdout run.
The Alibaba Cloud deployment still holds the earlier 735-chunk index; this 905-chunk result is an offline release gate.
